text:
leah: FYI: DAST job failing intermittently in prod-ish staging. error looks like "permission denied: DecryptKey" when scanner tries to fetch test creds. Happened on 3 runs in last hour.

omar: saw that too. scanner-sa was rotated yesterday as part of RBAC cleanup. could be missing kms:Decrypt in the new role.

jin: quick check: which principal did we bind the kms policy to? last I saw we had a group binding for scanners-team@redwood, not the scanner-sa.

leah: looks like the GCP service account changed from scanners@infra to scanners-runner@ci. RBAC doc updated but KMS policy not patched.

nina: oof. securing SA rotation is good but we need a checklist: update KMS bindings, audit-service mapping, and the scanner manifest.

security-bot: Alert: missing KMS permission detected for resource projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/scans/cryptoKeys/decrypt. See incident template SEC-IR-7.

omar: immediate fix: add kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt to scanners-runner@ci for the key, but let's make it time-limited and scoped to the staging project.

jin: agreed. but also we should verify audit logs contain the failed decrypt attempts. currently the CI runner logs the stack trace but I can't find corresponding CloudAudit entries for the denied API calls.

leah: I saw the runner logs with a stacktrace and a local error message but no full CloudAudit row. maybe the call failed before auth reached KMS? or logging sampling?

nina: two parallel asks: 1) patch RBAC to restore scans ASAP 2) figure out why the audit logs are missing entries — we need those for triage and for compliance retention.

oncall-bot: Created incident INC-8123 and paged oncall.

omar: making the RBAC change now (scoped, 1h expiry). ping when done and we can re-run.

leah: re-run queued.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline #4910: dast-scan job retry attempt #1 started.

jin: re-run still failed with decrypt error. I grabbed network captures; the runner did a signed request but the audit logs still don't show an attempted Decrypt call.

nina: suspicious. could be our proxy (kms-proxy) caching an old identity binding or silently blocking requests from certain IPs. Does runner go direct to KMS or to proxy?

leah: scanner config points to kms-proxy: https://kms-proxy.internal/unwrap. That proxy had a deploy earlier today.

omar: rolling back proxy to previous version to test. if rollback fixes it, we know the deploy introduced a bug.

deploy-bot: kms-proxy rollback to v2.7.3 initiated.

jin: after rollback, CI retry passed and scan completed. No CloudAudit decrypt entries still visible for the earlier failures, but when it worked I can see normal decrypt audit rows for the proxy service account.

nina: conclusion: proxy deploy likely dropped or rewrote some auth headers under specific error paths, causing KMS to reject requests without producing CloudAudit rows. We need a fix and a retro: better test coverage for proxy auth edge cases.

leah: action items: 1) Omar to add temporary RBAC fix for scanner-sa with 1h expiry (done) 2) Omar/Jin to create PR for proxy fix + tests for header preservation 3) Nina to update incident doc with artefacts + missing audit note 4) Leah to confirm compliance reporting gap and open SEC ticket if evidence missing for retention window.

omar: filing PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/kms-proxy/pull/1845 (WIP)

jin: unit/e2e tests to add: simulate proxy auth error paths, assert header passthrough and that 401/403 generate CloudAudit entries.

security-bot: Reminder: SEC-LOG-3 requires audit retention. If CloudAudit entries are missing for a run, record the runner logs and proxy logs in the evidence store and mark as "audit-incomplete" for the run.

nina: adding that to incident doc. Also recommend we add an automated pre-deploy smoke test that runs a fake decrypt through proxy and checks CloudAudit within 30s.

leah: +1 to smoke test. low-cost and would have caught this during the proxy deploy.

omar: PR opened and patch ready. will coordinate with release window.

leah: thanks everyone. will keep monitoring and will file SEC-IR followup with timeline and mitigation steps. Closing thread for now unless we see more failures. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Incident INC-8123 updated: status=mitigated, followup tasks assigned.
